digest.component_or_area: enrich gate marker (queue.py write-path drain gate)
propositions: A single pending queue entry disables the O(1) fast path marker and forces a full O(store) walk on every subsequent write until the pending set empties
The marker write logic uses all-or-nothing clearing: if any pending entries exist after a scan, the marker is never written, so repeated probes always trigger full-store walks
Measured performance shows a 4,938-ticket store pays 1,200–1,330 ms per write with even one pending entry, versus 0.110 ms with the fast path active
The proposed design generalizes the marker to record a 'live' set of ticket ids with enqueued entries, allowing scoped per-entry reductions O(backlog) instead of full walks O(store)
Scoped probes must not refresh the marker's TTL so that the TTL still bounds the time since the last full walk, preserving the existing append-during-scan race contract
The marker can only assert absence of pending work; a stale or wrong-typed marker must degrade to a full walk, never manufacture a pending ticket
